recreation_brief:
1. Set the full-slide background to light gray #F2F2F2.
2. Place the title block top-center (~5-20% of slide height): line 1 'Minimum Sum Squared Error (MSSE) Technique' in bold dark red #C00000 sans-serif, the largest text on the slide; line 2 directly beneath it, '(Least Squares)' in bold blue #0000CC, slightly smaller, centered.
3. Place the slide-number badge in the top-right corner: a circle filled yellow #FFFF99 with a dark red #C00000 outline, containing the numeral '27' in black, centered.
4. Place the left top box at middle-left (~30-60% height, ~8-42% width): a white #FFFFFF rectangle with a thin red #C00000 border. Inside: line 1, the equation 'W = (X_{N x d})^{-1} Y' with 'W' and 'Y' underlined and the term '(X_{N x d})^{-1}' overlaid with a pink #F8A5C2 rounded-rectangle highlight, plus a yellow #FFD700 sad-face emoji to the right of the equation; line 2, 'X_{N x d} is non-square matrix' in blue #0000CC; line 3, 'There is NO Inverse' in red #C00000 bold italic.
5. Place the left bottom box at lower-left (~65-80% height, ~8-42% width): a pale yellow #FFFFCC rectangle with a thin red #C00000 border. Inside: the equation 'W = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T Y' with 'W' underlined in black, 'Y' underlined in red #CC0000, and the portion '(X^T X)^{-1} X^T' overlaid with a pink #F8A5C2 rounded-rectangle highlight.
6. Place a large red #C00000 curly brace '}' in the center between the columns (~30-80% height), scaled so its arms open leftward and embrace both left boxes while its cusp points right toward the right column.
7. Place the heading 'Pseudo Inverse of Non-Square Matrix' in the right column at ~40% of slide height, in bold red #C00000 sans-serif.
8. Place the right top box at middle-right (~45-62% height, ~50-92% width): a pink #F8C8DC filled rectangle with a red #C00000 border containing the equation '(X_{N x d})^{-1} = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T' in blue #0000CC.
9. Place the right bottom box at lower-right (~68-92% height, ~50-85% width): a white #FFFFFF rectangle with a red #C00000 border. Inside: line 1 at top-left, 'Remember' in red #C00000 bold italic; line 2, the equation '(X^T_{d x N} X_{N x d})^{-1} = (...)^{-1}_{d x d}' in blue #0000CC with a light-blue #CCE5FF highlight behind it (reproduce the '(...)' ellipsis exactly as printed); line 3, 'In General: d <<< N' with 'd' and 'N' in red #CC0000 and the remaining words in black #000000, plus a yellow #FFD700 smiley-face emoji to the right of this line.
10. Apply typography globally: sans-serif for all non-math text; equations in Cambria Math (or an equivalent math-italic serif) with true subscripts for the dimension labels (N x d, d x N); render the equations as the largest text after the title so they remain the focal points inside their boxes.
